note: When may a model be adapted (fine-tuned, or a picture generator trained)? Only when ALL of the conditions of a track hold. tools/ai/adaptation_trigger.py reads the measured gate (content/ai/features.json), the remedies listed here and the data counts listed here, and says whether the trigger is met. Counts and remedies are hand-maintained statements that a reviewer can read; the gap is measured.
conditions: a measured quality gap: a suite of a feature in `features` that FAILS on committed results (a SKIPPED suite is a missing measurement, not a gap)
every remedy on the ladder is marked tried, with evidence
at least `min_training_examples` examples from a permitted source that is NOT the model's own output
a held-out evaluation set that shares no example with the training data
a compute budget that fits the 6 GB desktop card without taking it from live use for the training time

remedy_ladder.name: prompt versions (immutable, measured against the old)
completion or repair in code (dropped facts, shortlist, validators)
a larger or different served model
remedy_ladder.evidence: only qwen3.5 4B and 9B were measured; the medical candidate is gated (content/ai/model_candidates.json)

remedy_ladder.name: retrieval of approved examples into the prompt
remedy_ladder.evidence: retrieval exists (server/retrieval) but is not used for dialogue wording

tracks.training_source: none: the only dialogue we hold is model-written; tuning a model on its own output cannot show it improved
tracks.compute_note: the card serves the live 4B model; no training window exists

remedy_ladder.name: picture selection from the existing library
remedy_ladder.evidence: tools/content/imaging_tags.py: 29 findings have no real picture to select

remedy_ladder.name: painting findings into real base images (synthetic, labelled)
a licensed dataset holding the missing findings
remedy_ladder.evidence: none of the 14 registered sources holds a labelled picture of them (docs/research/generative_images_trigger.md)

tracks.compute_note: days of a free card, or a rented card with a cost recorded
